verdict.rationale: Parsec clearly supports reaching your own machine away from home. The docs say all connections are peer-to-peer and never pass through Parsec's infrastructure, and a community user reports streaming from their PC over a 4G network. The connection-path side is thinner: the only documented relay is a high-performance relay sold to Teams/Enterprise customers to connect through a firewall relay point, and there is no documented consumer relay fallback, port-forwarding, or VPN guidance. missing for 10: documented NAT-traversal/port-forwarding setup, consumer relay fallback path, VPN guidance, in-depth first-party networking docs beyond marketing copy.
